verdict: Paid ads are off; organic activity is slowing and needs support.
narrative: This period, all engagement came from your Google Business Profile — 93 total actions including 20 calls, 29 direction requests, and 44 website clicks — because paid advertising on Meta and Google has been inactive for at least 45 days, producing zero spend and zero leads. Over the last seven days, GBP actions fell 40% week-over-week, and the final three days of the period recorded no GBP activity at all, confirming the slowdown is real rather than routine fluctuation. Instagram reach also dropped 38% week-over-week, reducing organic social visibility by roughly half. Reactivating at least one paid channel is the immediate priority so that lead flow is no longer entirely dependent on organic search. Once paid traffic is live, you should see measurable leads and cost-per-lead figures return within the first reporting week.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions this period (calls, directions, web clicks)
leads and paid ad spend across Meta and Google in the last 28 days
drop in GBP engagement over the last 7 days vs. the prior 7 days

watch_item.issue: GBP actions went to zero for the last three days of the period, and Instagram reach has halved week-over-week — organic visibility is contracting across both channels.
watch_item.fix: Paid advertising is being reactivated to restore lead flow independent of organic dips, and content cadence is being reviewed to stabilize reach.
